meta.title: Composite kernels C^(2)_Delta, C^(2)_{P_b}; D_1, P_1 on the test families (final, after revision)
meta.unit: u = hbar tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/(16 pi^2 (X,Y)) = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2); kernel values hbar/(16 pi^2) x colour word; planar factor (-1)^r/2
meta.regulator: heat-kernel proper time: cutoff eps on every edge, P(eps,T) = int_eps^T (Q^GF (x) 1) K_t dt, T = infinity (generic momenta); no dimensional regularisation; no IR regulator other than T

routes.A: Schwinger/simplex exact, vertex form, injected momentum r
routes.B: momentum space, kernel form (Euler operator), Feynman parameters, exact + numerical eps check
routes.QA: independent momentum-space Taylor expansion (scalar sector) and own harmonic action

definitions.square_kernel: X = ((P*)^2 (x) 1) K_0; component c (x) A_V: 2 i p_m e^{-2 eps |p|^2} |p|^{-4} (two Schwinger segments in [eps, infinity))
definitions.composite_kernels: K_x = (v_x. (x) 1 - 1 (x) v_x.) X;  K_Delta = 2 (v. (x) 1) X + 4 (eps d_eps + T d_T) X;  K_{P_b} = 2 (d_b (x) 1) X
definitions.internal_vertex: Delta: int((2E+2) A_V, A*_V) = 2 int x^mu (d_mu A_V, A*_V) + 2 int (A_V, A*_V);  P_b: int (d_b A_V, A*_V)
definitions.Z_x: Z_x(X_a,X_b;eps) = (hbar/2) d_{K_x} d_{K_eps - K_0}(amputated chains X_a -> X_b) = -(hbar/2) d_{K_x}(chains with one bracket-defect vertex)
definitions.koszul_sign: s(c,sigma) = (-1)^{n(<sigma) + n(<c) + [c<sigma]}, n(<j) = number of odd outputs before edge j
definitions.C2: C^(2)_x(X_a,X_b) = coefficient of eps^0 of Z_x; C^(2),0_Delta its translation-invariant part; (C^(2)_Delta)^b = 2 C^(2)_{P_b}; [C^(2),0_Delta, d_b] = 2 C^(2)_{P_b}
definitions.simplex_form: 16 pi^2 [eps^0] = int_{R_sigma} F_0 log(min_{f != sigma} alpha_f / alpha_sigma) d alpha;  16 pi^2 [eps^-m] = (1/m) int_{R_sigma} [(min alpha_f)^m - alpha_sigma^m] F_m;  no log eps
definitions.k1_weights: W_0(beta) = (1-beta) log((1-beta)/(2 beta)) - (1 - 3 beta), beta in [0, 1/3]; W_m(beta) = (2/m)[(((1-beta)/2)^{m+1} - beta^{m+1})/(m+1) - beta^m ((1-beta)/2 - beta)]
definitions.N: N(int omega X_1...X_n) = sum_a (2 + |alpha_a|) int omega X_1...X_n
definitions.free_directions: hbar F_1^(1)(Delta) = 4uF + F^tr + u sum_d theta_d S_d + u Q(kappa_V int(iota_x A_V, c*) + kappa_lambda int(rho(x) lambda*, lambda*)) + cubic; F^tr = u[-2/3 int(A,A*) + 1/3 int(lambda*,lambda) + 4/3 int(c*,c)]; hbar F_1^(1)(P_b) = u sum_d thetaP_d S_d(P_b) + kappaP terms

two_component.letters: A_V -> A_m, A_perp -> A_ij (6 of SU(4)), lambda_+ -> lambda_alpha^i, lambda_- -> lambdabar_{alphadot i}; antifields A*_m, A*_ij, lambda*^alpha_i, lambdabar*^{alphadot i}, c*
two_component.pairing: (lambda, lambda*) = (lambda_alpha^i, lambda*^alpha_i) - (lambdabar_{alphadot i}, lambdabar*^{alphadot i}); (u,w) = (1/4) u^ij w_ij on W_R^perp
two_component.internal_vertex: int((2E+2)A_m, A*_m) = 2 int x_n (d_n A_m, A*_m) + 2 int (A_m, A*_m)
two_component.S_sectors_P: S_perp(P_b) = (1/4) int (b_m d_m A^ij, A*_ij); S_lambda(P_b) = -int[(b.d lambda_alpha^i, lambda*^alpha_i) - (b.d lambdabar_{alphadot i}, lambdabar*^{alphadot i})]; S_V(P_b) = int (b.d A_n, A*_n) - int (b.d c, c*)
two_component.kappa_directions: Q int x_m (A_m, c*), Q int (rho(x) lambda*, lambda*) = -2i Q int x_m (lambda*^alpha_i, sigma^m_{alpha alphadot} lambdabar*^{alphadot i})
two_component.Srednicki: A_m = -i g A^a_m T^a, u = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2), -u/3 = g^2 N/(96 pi^2), gamma = (g^2 N/(8 pi^2)) E_H, D_1 = 2 gamma

bilinear.index_free: C^(2)_Delta(A_perp, A_perp)|_{A_perp A_perp} = -(1/3) u v.O - (4/3) u O; C^(2)_{P_b} = -(1/3) u d_b O; C^(2),0_Delta = -(8/3) u O (traceless and trace)
bilinear.two_component: O = (1/16) int omega w1^ij A_ij w2^kl A_kl: C^(2)_Delta = u[-(1/3)((2x.d+2)A_ij) A_kl - (1/3) A_ij (2x.d+2) A_kl - (4/3) A_ij A_kl]
bilinear.chain: A_perp -[K_eps - K_0]- ([A_perp, c], A*_perp) -[K_Delta]- A_V (A_perp)^2 -[P]- A_perp

D1_P1_with_free_directions.index_free: on cohomology of every family: D_1 = 4 lc^natural - u sum_a (theta_{d(a)} + 1/3) v.X_a;  P_1 = -u sum_a (thetaP_{d(a)} + 1/3) d_b X_a;  kappa_V, kappa_lambda s-exact
D1_P1_with_free_directions.two_component: v.X = (2 x_m d_m + 2 w_X) X on a letter; Xi_Delta = -(1/3 + theta) u (2 x_m d_m + 2 w_O) for equal theta
D1_P1_with_free_directions.arity_two: position part of D_1 s-exact (Thm cc-arity2) => theta_perp = theta_lambda = theta_V = -1/3 (Prop cc-theta-sector; families F1, F2 fermion, F3 gluon)
D1_P1_with_free_directions.result: Xi_Delta = 0, D_1 = 4 lc^natural, Spec D_1 = -8 u E_H = (g^2 N/(4 pi^2)) E_H; P_1 = 0 in the translation-covariant scheme (thetaP = theta)

A.note: With sector-dependent theta the two-field part sees only the sectors of its leading letters; the gauge completion (A|_V letters, sector V) enters the three-field part, so gauge covariance of D_1 couples theta_V to theta_perp, theta_lambda (Conjecture P7 (a), not tested here).  Translation-covariant scheme: thetaP = theta, P_1 = D_1^b / 2.

B.statement: on every family computed (two-field shell, cohomology): sum C2_{P_b} = -(1/3) u d_b and sum C2^0_Delta = -(2/3) u N, so
B.D1_position_part: (D_1)^b = 2 sum C2_{P_b} - 2u sum_a theta_{diamond(a)} d_b X_a = -2u sum_a (1/3 + theta_{diamond(a)}) d_b X_a
B.D1_translation_invariant: D_1^0 = 4 lc^natural + sum_a u(c_phi - 2 theta_{diamond(a)} w_a) X_a - (2/3) u N = 4 lc^natural - 2u sum_a (1/3 + theta_{diamond(a)}) w_a X_a (c_A = 2/3, c_lambda = 1/3, sum_a (c_phi + (2/3) w_a) = (2/3) N); kappa_V, kappa_lambda terms s-exact, zero on the shell
B.Xi_Delta: -u sum_a (1/3 + theta_{diamond(a)}) v.|_{letter a}; equal theta: -(1/3 + theta) u {S^(1)(Delta),-}
B.arity_two: position part exact (Thm thm:cc-arity2) and d_b O not exact on these families => theta_perp = theta_lambda = theta_V = -1/3 on every family with letters of that sector (F1: theta_perp; F2 fermion: theta_lambda; F3 gluon: theta_V; mixed families: all), D_1 = 4 lc^natural
B.P1: P_1 = sum C2_{P_b} - u sum_a theta^P_{diamond(a)} d_b X_a = -u sum_a (1/3 + theta^P_{diamond(a)}) d_b X_a (+ kappa^P terms, s-exact); translation-covariant scheme theta^P = theta = -1/3: P_1 = 0 (Cor cor:cc-theta (iii)); equal theta^P: P_1 = u(theta - theta^P) d_b at theta = -1/3
B.two_component: D_1 = -8 u E_H = (g^2 N/(4 pi^2)) E_H on eigenstates; P_1 = -(1/3 + theta^P) u b_m d_m, -(1/3) u = g^2 N/(96 pi^2)

TC0_quadratic_directions.statement: H^{-1}(Q) on Spin(4)xSpin(6)-invariant quadratic functionals of weight 4, position degree <= 1: parity even = span{S_perp, S_lambda, S_V}; Q-exact: Q int(iota_x A_V,c*), Q int(rho(x) lambda*,lambda*); parity odd adds int(lambda*, rho(v1v2v3v4) lambda) = int[(lambda_alpha^i,lambda*^alpha_i) + (lambdabar_{alphadot i}, lambdabar*^{alphadot i})]
